free_tier.stated: every Vercel team account has a free tier with a monthly included credit usable on a subset of the catalogue, with a lower per-model rate limit than the paid tier; the credit starts at the first AI Gateway request and stops applying once AI Gateway Credits are purchased. USD 5 of credits every 30 days per the vendor's launch post of 2025-08-21; the current pricing page prints 'monthly free credit' and no amount. Models priced $0 for input and output also exist; their ids are in free_tier.notes
free_tier.notes: the free-tier model list is a filtered view of the catalogue (freeTier=true) that renders only in the browser, so the eligible set is not enumerated here; the keyless list at https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models prices these language ids at input 0 and output 0: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free, poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free, reflection/beam, reflection/beam-free and stealth/glyph-cluster; whether $0 ids also need the payment method on file is unverified

tooling: AI SDK, or any OpenAI-compatible client at the gateway base URL; model ids are provider/model
chaining: free credit plus several $0 models behind one key; the paid tier removes the gateway's own limits

limits.value: USD 5 of credits every 30 days per the vendor's launch post of 2025-08-21; the current pricing page prints 'monthly free credit' and no amount; the credit stops applying once AI Gateway Credits are purchased
unverified: the free tier applies a lower limit per model and the vendor page 'describes behavior rather than fixed numbers'; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with type rate_limit_exceeded

identity_cost.detail: a Vercel account plus a valid payment method added to the Vercel team before the free AI Gateway Credits can be used ('To use free AI Gateway Credits, add a valid payment method to your team'); unverified: no page read states whether the card is only verified or also charged

reliability_note: a 429 on either tier can come from the upstream provider rather than the gateway; the free credit no longer applies after any credit purchase
confidence_note: the free tier, the lower per-model limit, the credit basis, the payment-method requirement and the USD 5 every 30 days credit are quoted from vendor pages; the per-model limits are unpublished, and the USD 5 figure comes from the launch post of 2025-08-21, not from the current pricing page.
